input.quote: 14.9 Bankruptcy. The parties hereto agree that Corio, as a licensee of Commerce One's intellectual property, shall be afforded all of the protections afforded to a licensee under Section 365(n) of the United States Bankruptcy Code
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance provision (a text search returns only an incidental reference to insurance in the Net Revenue definition), yet Commerce One is a services/hosting vendor: it supplies on-site operations consultants and professional services under Sections 5.1, 5.2 and 5.6 and its hosted Software/MarketSite.net Service handles Corio's and its Customers' data. Under the playbook we require CGL of USD 1M/2M, E&O of USD 2M, cyber of USD 5M, statutory workers' compensation and certificates on request. Inserted as new Section 14.10 in Miscellaneous, with the existing entire-agreement clause renumbered 14.11.

proposal.summary: Insert an insurance covenant as new Section 14.10 requiring Commerce One to carry CGL, E&O, cyber and workers' compensation coverage and to furnish certificates.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance provision even though Commerce One personnel provide on-site installation, implementation and professional services and its hosted MarketSite.net Service handles Corio's and its Customers' data, so we have added a standard insurance covenant (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request). If these limits are an issue we can fall back to E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber liability of USD 2,000,000.

ops.text: 14.10 Insurance. Commerce One shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; (c) where Commerce One processes or has access to Corio's or its Customers' data, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and (d) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. Commerce One shall provide Corio with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request.
